data.one_liner: Calculates Islamic prayer times, Qibla, and Madina directions based on coordinates.
data.what_it_does: Seamlessly calculates accurate Islamic prayer times (Namaz times), sunnah times, and Qibla or Madina directions according to geographical coordinates and calculation parameters. It provides utilities to determine current and next prayer times.
use_when: You need to calculate Islamic prayer times based on different calculation methods and madhabs.
You need to determine Qibla or Madina direction from a specific geographical location.
avoid_when: You are building a general map or GPS routing application unrelated to prayer timing.
strengths: Supports multiple calculation methods and madhabs.
Provides convenience utilities for current and next prayer timings as well as Qibla direction.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on geographical coordinates passed to it without built-in automated location fetching in the snippet.
Limited documentation on advanced customization beyond provided examples.
